title: Choose the visual world for Simplex Aluminium
question: The roll assigned The Measurement Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Measurement Sheet
options.lineage: the installer's site-measurement visit: tape, pencil, graph paper, dimension lines in millimetres
options.thesis: The page is a measured drawing of your room; every window, door and cupboard arrives with its dimension lines already drawn, and the company is the pencil.
materials: near-white drafting sheet with a faint 8px grid
hairline dimension lines with open arrowheads
one grotesque for display, one mono for millimetres
options.viewport: A full-height sheet. Left: 'Simplex Aluminium' small in mono, then a 96px display line 'Measured. Made. Fitted.' Right: a large line-drawn sliding window elevation whose dimension lines extend in from the margins and count up to their millimetre figures as the page loads. Call and WhatsApp sit as two sharp black rectangles under the headline; the same pair lives in a sticky bottom bar on phones.
options.risk: If the line work is timid or the photos are muddy it reads as a template with arrows; the drawings must be exact and the three photographs must be sharp.

raised.raise: The sheet is almost white but never neutral: it drifts warm at the top-left corner and cool at the bottom-right, so it reads as paper, not a rendered #fff.
Dimension lines grow in from the margins along their own length and leave a clearing for the text; nothing on the page fades in.
Two faces only, no weight zoo: hierarchy is made from size, case and 1px rules, and state prints itself as a changing millimetre figure.
With reduced motion every dimension renders already drawn and every counter already at its final figure.
Sections are labelled with their literal nouns in mono caps (WINDOWS, DOORS, CUPBOARDS, INTERIORS); wayfinding is reading.
Sections stack as separate cut sheets with a hard 1px edge and real gaps between them, never a continuous scroll of soft bands.

options.label: The Sliding Sash
options.lineage: the sliding window itself: two panes in parallel tracks, an interlock, glass with a thin reflection
options.thesis: The page moves the way a Simplex window moves: sections are sashes that slide past each other in tracks, and the product's mechanism is the site's navigation.
materials: glass panes with one diagonal hairline reflection
options.viewport: Two full-height panes side by side; the left pane carries the headline and the Call / WhatsApp pair, the right pane is a photograph of fitted work. Scrolling slides the right sash across the left along a visible track, revealing the next section behind it.
options.risk: The most memorable of the seven, and the one most likely to be read as a gimmick if the sliding is not dead smooth on a mid-range Android; also closer to where premium fabricator sites already land.

options.label: Design Annual Plate Section
options.lineage: a design annual's plate section on uncoated near-white stock
options.thesis: Simplex's work presented as numbered plates with registration crosshairs, a credits row and one periwinkle stamp.
options.viewport: A sticky mono token bar, a 92px grotesque headline, then a 4-up plate row of fitted work with crosshairs at every corner and a rotating text-ring stamp half off the first plate.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: photographs of finished work are plates, and the hairline-and-mono grammar is the assigned direction's cousin; it holds product clarity but a homeowner does not identify with a design annual.
options.risk: Reads as a portfolio for designers, not a fabricator for homeowners, unless the plates are unmistakably real rooms.

options.label: Krakow Secession Page
options.lineage: a Mloda Polska review page with a folk-flower border growing inward
options.thesis: Ornament grows in from the margins and leaves a clearing for the text.
materials: flat-printed ornament with a fine outline
options.viewport: A symmetrical floral border closing in on a hand-lettered headline.
options.case: Loses both axes: organic ornament contradicts a material whose whole promise is the straight, sealed edge.
options.kept: Lines grow in from the margins along their length and leave a clearing; motion is growth, never a fade.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.lineage: a green-phosphor terminal in a midnight machine room
options.thesis: One monospaced face, one glowing transcript.
options.viewport: A blinking cursor typing the company's offer line by line.
options.case: Loses both axes: a homeowner on a phone does not identify with a machine room, and dark glass hides the light-catching material.
options.kept: Total type discipline: hierarchy from size, case and rules; state prints itself.

options.label: Hand-drawn Zine
options.lineage: a hand-drawn technical zine with marker lettering and doodle arrows
options.thesis: A friend sketches how a window is fitted on a napkin.
options.viewport: A marker headline over a doodled window with looping arrows.
options.case: Loses both axes: cheerful marker is the opposite of the premium, sharp-edged brief.
options.kept: Draw-on tied to scroll, and reduced-motion renders everything already drawn.

options.label: Industrial Quote Grammar
options.lineage: industrial streetwear: caps in straight quotes, zip-tie tags, hazard stripes
options.thesis: Every zone named by its literal word in quotes under a diagonal hazard stripe.
options.viewport: "WINDOWS" in giant caps with a hazard stripe running under it.
options.case: Loses both axes: fashion-stockroom irony is not how a homeowner chooses who fits their kitchen, and stripes break the minimal-colour constraint.
options.kept: Sections labelled with their literal nouns; wayfinding is reading.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.lineage: a surreal quarry where workers cut blocks of weather
options.thesis: Sections stack like cut blocks with deep blue gaps between them.
options.viewport: A silver saw line opening a white block onto blue.
options.case: Loses both axes: the surreal premise adds nothing a homeowner can identify with and obscures what Simplex makes.
options.kept: Sections stack as cut blocks with hard edges and real gaps, measurements in mono.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What aluminium fabricator sites ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A dark hero photo of a glass facade, white sans headline, orange 'Get a Quote' button, then Services, Projects, Why Us, Testimonials, Contact.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other fabricator in the search results, by design.
